note_gaps: Fig. 1's plot of average Newton-like solver iterations vs. contact count/friction coefficient did not survive parsing (no numeric values); per-pair contact-point counts are not stated.
contact_model: soft, convex velocity-stepping contact; three interchangeable solvers replace the standard LCP-with-friction-pyramid approach: implicit-complementarity, convex (kinetic-energy minimization with a soft non-penetration cost), and diagonal (mass-aware spring-damper)
solver: implicit-complementarity solver (customized non-smooth Newton method, most accurate); convex solver (interior-point method used for reported timings; projected Newton/CG/Gauss-Seidel also mentioned as unverified-faster alternatives); diagonal solver (per-contact critically-damped spring-damper using the diagonal of the A matrix, fastest/least accurate)
throughput: up to ~400,000 dynamics evaluations/sec on a 12-physical-core machine (2x 6-core Intel X5860 3.33GHz, 24 threads via hyper-threading), 3D humanoid with 18 DOF and 6 active contacts (Abstract, Table 3)
